provenance.calculation: Per-game FG% per zone; ShotChartDetail LOC_X/LOC_Y are tenths of a foot with the origin at the attacking hoop, LOC_X lateral and LOC_Y away from the baseline. Map to the canonical right-attacking CourtGeometry frame as x = 88.75 - LOC_Y/10 and y = 25 + LOC_X/10; the lateral reflection choice does not change these four symmetric shot zones. Coordinate radius reproduces floor(SHOT_DISTANCE) for all 218,701 attempts. Then evaluate NBA three-point geometry (23.75 ft arc, 22 ft corner, 3 ft sideline depth) with the production CourtGeometry::shot_zone boundaries: rim <5 ft, near [5,14) ft, mid >=14 ft inside the arc, three outside. For zone assignment, preserve a three-point label when either court geometry or NBA ShotChartDetail SHOT_TYPE marks it three-point; the classifications disagree on 22 of 218,701 attempts. Report the coordinate-geometry rate independently against the official 3PA/FGA benchmark, and use the union only to avoid assigning ambiguous attempts to the mid zone. Bands are empirical game-level 5th-95th percentiles using linear interpolation (pandas quantile default). Q4 final 300 seconds is compared with Q4 earlier than 300 seconds, both teams pooled per game; all 1,230 games are retained and the statistic is late-window 3PA/FGA minus early-window 3PA/FGA. The 1,230-game mean delta is +0.02132 and median is +0.01711; the reference band is the empirical 5th-95th percentile. Overtime excluded. No simulation outputs used.

q4_late_three_attempt_share.interval_method: Empirical per-game 5th-95th percentiles by linear interpolation; 1230 regular-season games; both teams pooled; minimum 9 FGA in each window; OT excluded.
